name: web-debug
description: Evidence-first local web debugging, complex repair verification, and responsive visual QA for Codex and ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Reproduce local web bugs with bounded evidence.
interface.longDescription: Inspect and repair a running local web app through browser, React, Vite, Next.js, Safari, debugger, replay, responsive viewport, and fix-verification evidence.
defaultPrompt: Reproduce this local web bug and capture evidence.
Inspect this React, Vite, or Next.js issue.
Verify this frontend fix against the recorded flow.
Debug this responsive visual issue at desktop and mobile sizes.
Compare this bug with and without Web Debug evidence.
